##### Project general facts

Riviera 65 is a contemporary residential development located in Meydan’s vibrant community in Dubai. The complex comprises four residential buildings with private road access and a lively boulevard offering a variety of recreational and lifestyle activities. The development provides a selection of studios and one- and two-bedroom apartments, combining modern urban living with a range of amenities and services within close reach.

The community offers a convenient lifestyle with cafes, restaurants, shops, and convenience stores located just steps from the residences. Riviera 65 is also positioned approximately seven minutes from Downtown Dubai, providing convenient access to one of the city’s major business, retail, and entertainment destinations. Residents can enjoy a combination of everyday convenience and proximity to Dubai’s key attractions.

A central feature of Riviera 65 is the crystal lagoon with sandy beaches, available exclusively to residents and designed for swimming and watersports. The apartments feature modern finishes made with high-quality materials and equipped kitchens, while the residences are delivered unfurnished. The combination of contemporary interiors, waterfront leisure facilities, and convenient amenities creates a comfortable residential environment.

##### Location description and benefits

Mohammed Bin Rashid City is a major urban development in Dubai featuring a wide selection of high-end residential properties, including villas, mansions, and luxury apartments. The area is characterized by modern and contemporary architecture, with developments incorporating advanced technologies and sustainable design approaches.

The community offers a range of green spaces, parks, and landscaped gardens that provide opportunities for outdoor recreation and relaxation. Dubai Canal is another prominent feature of the area, creating a waterfront environment and adding to the appeal of residential communities located nearby. These spaces contribute to a diverse urban setting that combines modern development with outdoor amenities.

MBR City also provides access to a variety of entertainment, cultural, leisure, retail, and dining destinations. Dubai Hills Estate, with its championship golf course, residential communities, retail, and dining options, is located within the wider area, while other planned attractions include theme parks, art galleries, museums, and sports facilities. The combination of residential, recreational, and cultural destinations supports a varied modern lifestyle.
